limitations: node3 could not resolve node2 by name; its direct check was retried using node2's live DMZ address.

probes.summary: Read-only operational-state checks completed on all four nodes; node1 retains task-named debug, capture, and setup artifacts.

assertions.summary: All zone addresses and primary data-plane routes use the intended interfaces.

evidence.command: ifconfig; netstat -rn; pfctl -sr; pfctl -sn; sudo -H python3 -c "...parse /conf/config.xml..."
evidence.observation: node1 has WAN vtnet1=10.10.0.1/24, LAN vtnet2=10.20.0.1/24, DMZ vtnet3=10.30.0.1/24. Connected routes use the corresponding interfaces; vtnet0=10.100.239.10 is the separate management network. Saved XML maps wan=vtnet1, opt1=vtnet2, opt2=vtnet3.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show
evidence.observation: node2 has DMZ enp8s0=10.30.0.2/24 and primary default route via 10.30.0.1 dev enp8s0; management route is metric 1000.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show
evidence.observation: node3 has LAN enp8s0=10.20.0.3/24 and primary default route via 10.20.0.1 dev enp8s0; management route is metric 1000.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show
evidence.observation: node4 has WAN enp8s0=10.10.0.4/24 and primary default route via 10.10.0.1 dev enp8s0; management route is metric 1000.

limitations: OPNsense configctl interface/firewall listing actions were unavailable, but direct ifconfig, netstat, pfctl, and saved XML evidence was available.

assertions.summary: LAN reaches the DMZ service directly on TCP 8080, and WAN reaches the same content only through the 8443 DNAT.

evidence.command: ifconfig; netstat -rn; pfctl -sr; pfctl -sn; sudo -H python3 -c "...parse /conf/config.xml..."
evidence.observation: Active pf contains LAN vtnet2 pass to 10.30.0.2 port 8080 and WAN vtnet1 rdr pass from port 8443 to 10.30.0.2 port 8080. Saved XML contains the matching WAN port-forward and LAN-to-DMZ rule.

evidence.command: ip -4 route get 10.30.0.2; curl -fsS -D - --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 8 http://10.30.0.2:8080/
evidence.observation: Route is via 10.20.0.1 dev enp8s0 from 10.20.0.3. Request returned HTTP/1.0 200 OK with body containing infraset-dmz.

evidence.command: ip -4 route get 10.10.0.1; curl -fsS -D - --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 8 http://10.10.0.1:8443/
evidence.observation: Route is directly via WAN enp8s0 from 10.10.0.4. Request returned HTTP/1.0 200 OK with body containing infraset-dmz.

limitations: node3 name resolution for node2 was unavailable; the fallback target was the live DMZ address established by the node2 probe.

assertions.summary: Concrete task-named debug, capture, and setup residue remains on node1.

evidence.command: ls -l /conf/config.xml.infraset-original /conf/config.xml.bak /conf/backup /tmp/cap-vtnet1 /tmp/cap-vtnet2 /tmp/cap-vtnet3 /tmp/infraset-opnsense.py /tmp/infraset-opnsense-pass.py /tmp/ifconfig.debug /tmp/ifconfig.debug.old /tmp/interfaces_neighbors.json /tmp/rules.debug /tmp/rules.debug.old; file /tmp/cap-vtnet1 /tmp/cap-vtnet2 /tmp/cap-vtnet3 /tmp/infraset-opnsense.py /tmp/infraset-opnsense-pass.py
evidence.observation: Present residue includes /conf/config.xml.infraset-original, /tmp/cap-vtnet1, /tmp/cap-vtnet2, /tmp/cap-vtnet3, /tmp/infraset-opnsense.py, /tmp/infraset-opnsense-pass.py, /tmp/ifconfig.debug and .old, /tmp/rules.debug and .old, and /tmp/interfaces_neighbors.json.

evidence.command: pfctl -si; pfctl -ss; pfctl -sr; pfctl -sn
evidence.observation: pf is enabled with 14 current states; active policy contains the intended LAN pass and WAN 8443 DNAT, with no broad WAN management pass observed.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; ip -4 route show table all; ss -ltnup; find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home -type f -print
evidence.observation: No failed units; one intended HTTP listener on 0.0.0.0:8080 plus platform SSH/DNS listeners; no evaluator files found in searched paths.
